primary_goal: 在真实 run_scenario 前端中，以独立进程比较默认冷 provider 与同场景显式 provider 预热复用的仿真器 wall/RSS；确认输出/TaskResult 报告等价，并保留无安全生产缓存调用方的边界。
hypothesis: TopologyAwareBatchCostProvider 在同一不可变场景显式复用时可降低重复 run_scenario 的仿真器构建 wall time；若结果等价但无共享生命周期、淘汰和场景身份契约，则只能作为局部工程证据。

source_identity.measured_candidate_mode: warm explicit TopologyAwareBatchCostProvider (one warm-up, measured second run)

data_roles.development: same deterministic build_reference_scenario workload and provider cache controls
data_roles.comparison: 20 independent cold/warm process pairs, alternating AB/BA across three request scales
data_roles.holdout: request scale distribution: 7 pairs 1x64x4, 7 pairs 8x128x16, 6 pairs 16x128x16; all requests share fixed IDs/input within pair
data_roles.final_acceptance: engineering runtime/memory only; no Native accuracy or production cache promotion

input_contract.cold: default run_scenario with provider constructed internally
input_contract.warm: explicit TopologyAwareBatchCostProvider, one unmeasured warm-up then measured second run

entrypoint.warm: build_reference_scenario -> TopologyAwareBatchCostProvider(scenario) -> warm run_scenario -> measured run_scenario(batch_lowerer=provider) -> report_dict

commands.role: 20 independent AB/BA process pairs; artifact written successfully

observations.output_equivalence: All 20/20 pair report_dict JSON hashes, makespan_ns, batch_count and request_count equal; all 40 children exit 0.
observations.wall_metric: Measured run_scenario wall seconds inside each child; parent process wall and peak RSS also collected in artifact pairs.
observations.rss_metric: Parent polled independent child process RSS with psutil; median RSS is process-level engineering memory, not Native memory.

decision.finding: 暖显式 provider 在三个规模均降低 measured run wall median（约 -57.90%、-74.37%、-74.19%），所有输出和 makespan 等价；RSS 仅大规模约 -1.85%，小规模约 +0.07%、中规模持平，不能称稳定内存改善。
decision.acceptance: 接纳为 context-local provider reuse 的独立前端工程证据；拒绝晋升生产候选，因为普通 run_scenario/run_jobs/Web 没有已定义共享 provider 生命周期、场景身份和淘汰契约。

uncovered: 没有安全的跨请求/Web/run_jobs/global provider cache 调用方；暖路径仅显式 provider 控制，不是新增生产机制。
没有 provider eviction、并发竞争、跨场景隔离或生命周期压力测试。
没有 Native/真实硬件 latency、TTFT/TPOT/E2E 或预测精度数据。
RSS 采样为父进程轮询，非系统级 peak working set；不把小/中规模 RSS 视为改善。
不重复 H54 CompilationContext 复用批次；本批针对 H36 provider 显式 reuse 入口。

next_basis.reason: H36 已完成真实前端性能边界；无安全缓存候选，切换到仍待补 H44/H52/H58 等成本链路，不重复同一 provider reuse 扫描。
